description:
Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.
Why you'll love this role
Our Technology Team is on a mission to build the next-generation e-commerce platform for the next generation of customers. We create world-class, innovative experiences and products that give our users access to the world’s most-coveted products and unlock economic opportunities by turning reselling into a business for anyone. Our team uses cutting-edge technologies that handle massive scales globally.
Supply Chain Engineering builds the systems that get products from sellers to buyers: tracking, logistics, and the verification workflows that make sure every item meets StockX standards. We’re looking for a frontend engineer to build the interfaces that power these experiences, from delivery tracking to the tools our operations and verification teams use every day.
You’ll be primarily focused on the frontend (React, TypeScript, Next.js), but our team owns its services end to end. You’ll also have the chance to debug, troubleshoot, and contribute to our Node.js/TypeScript backend services when the work calls for it. We think this makes our frontend engineers better, and we’ll support you in getting up to speed. In this role, you’ll make our supply chain experiences a delight for our users across the world and help make our supply chain more efficient. You’ll have room to take on more ownership as experience grows.
Our technical stack comprises various systems and services built on AWS. On the frontend, we use TypeScript, React, and Next.js. On the backend, we use Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, GraphQL, CircleCI, Harness, Kubernetes, Kafka, DynamoDB, and Aurora DB (Postgres).
What you'll do
Build and ship complex, data-heavy user interfaces in React, TypeScript, and Next.js for customers and internal operations teams.
Partner with product, design, program managers, and stakeholders to clarify requirements, recommend technical approaches, and push back on scope when it’s the right call.
Break down features into well-scoped components and contribute to design discussions, with growing ownership of the design as you build experience.
Write and maintain automated tests, and help improve our CI/CD pipelines and release practices.
Integrate with REST and GraphQL services, and when issues cross the frontend/backend boundary, dig in: trace them, debug them, and contribute fixes to our Node.js services.
Help keep what we ship healthy in production: willingness to take part in our regular on-call rotation, monitor production health (we use Datadog), and respond to production issues with urgency.
Contribute to team standards, share what you learn, and keep stakeholders informed when issues arise.
About you
3-5 years of professional software engineering experience, with most of it on the frontend.
Strong experience with React and TypeScript, including state management (such as Zustand or Redux) and building complex UIs.
Solid grounding in web fundamentals: performance, accessibility, security, and internationalization.
Experience integrating with REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
Hands-on experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines. We use GitHub, Kubernetes, Harness, and LaunchDarkly.
Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to explain tradeoffs and challenge scope constructively.
Comfort reading and debugging backend code (JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js, or a similar language like Java, C#, or PHP) and a willingness to contribute to it.
Experience with AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) in your development workflows.
Nice to have
Experience with using Datadog (APM, RUM, metrics) or similar observability tools.
Experience with AWS or another cloud provider and with data storage, particularly Postgres, Redis, and DynamoDB.
Experience in Supply Chain domains (warehouse or transportation management systems, carrier integrations, brand protection).
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.
Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $120,000 to $130,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary.
About StockX
StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com.
